items.q: he'd come out to Webster Groves and give us our instruction.

ctx.x: But you would imagine so. Did P. G. Langford come out to Webster Groves each week?

Each week. We lived across from the school. That's where our home is now, my brother's home and each week he'd come out to Webster Groves and give us our instruction. Now we first went to Mr. Sims' home where we first got together and the selection of this thing was a gasser. He said, 'Well, what do you think you want to play, young fellow?'
